text:
Ana: Draft's here — product launch blog v1: https://drive.redwood/launch/draft-v1.md
Ana: TL;DR: hero claim + benchmark callouts + webinar CTA. Want signoff on hero claim, bench phrasing, and CTAs.
Mike: Quick read. Two notes: 1) Bench numbers need context (seq len, batch). 2) 'half the cost' is a strong claim.
Sam: @Mike @Ana Legal: can't approve 'half' without a reproducible benchmark file. Either provide the csv link or change to 'up to 50% lower per-token cost' and add caveat.
Ana: Uploaded bench csv: https://s3.redwood/benchmarks/dedicated_apr24.csv
Ana: Bench tested on t4x, seq=512, avg throughput 2.4x vs baseline, median latency 45ms. See notes in the csv.
Mike: Nice. Can we add one-liner in blog: 'benchmark run: 512 tokens, inference workload X, compared to baseline Y (see appendix)'
Lee: Growth input: CTA variants — A) 'Join launch webinar' B) 'Get early access'. Lean B for product-qualified leads, but webinar helps demos. Recommend A on hero, B as secondary.
Caroline: Ops: inbound routing — map webinar registrants to HubSpot list 'Launch-Webinar-Apr24' and mark source=blog. Also set lead score +10 for registrants. Snippet:
```
utm_source=redwood
utm_medium=blog
utm_campaign=dedicated_launch_apr24
utm_content=cta_webinar
```
Caroline: HubSpot mapping: List=Launch-Webinar-Apr24, Workflow=Add to demo-nurture-track
Sam: Legal ok with 'up to 50% lower per-token cost' + link to benchmarks. Approve with that language.
Ana: Updated hero: 'High-performance LLM inference with up to 50% lower per-token cost — production-ready today.'
Mike: Looks good. Please add the appendices note and a small methods section for bench setup.
Lee: Copy for CTA A (hero button): 'Join launch webinar — Apr 24' CTA B (inline): 'Request early access'
publish-bot: Scheduled publish: 2024-04-24T09:00:00-07:00 (PDT) — blog + UTM + HubSpot mapping.
Ana: Thanks everyone. I'll push final to CMS and ping the PR channel when live :rocket:
